==Skins==
{{Tabber
|Default
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:Skeletonlunar.png|200px]]
|Made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid.

Does not have a full torso, but instead has a partial ribcage.

Head is slightly smaller than most other enemies, and it has two large black eyeholes.
}}
|Mage
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:MageSkeleton.png|200px]]
|Made out of brown wooden parts.

Has two neon green eyes and a neon green core in its torso.
}}
|Fallen
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:FallenSkeleton.png|200px]]
|Made entirely of black parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid.

Shoulders are grey.

Does not have a full torso, but instead has a partial ribcage.

Head is slightly smaller than most other enemies, and it has two large blue eyeholes.
}}
|Duck
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:DuckSkeleton.png|200px]]
|Small white duck, with an orange beak and feet.

Wears a gray helmet on its head.

Black stripes under its eyes.
}}
|Creepy Santa
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:CreepySantaSkeleton.png|200px]]
|White snowman with sticks as arms, green stone eyes and buttons, carrot nose, sharp teeth, black tophat and a red scarf.
}}
